comment: Reference-renderer test suites adopted as grading corpora. Each entry pins the upstream repository, the audited revision, and the subpath copied into corpus/reference/<id>. Fetch with scripts/fetch-reference-corpus.sh.

sources.description: The largest math-rendering corpus: LaTeX-to-output cases with per-case goldens.
The MathJax test-suite repository (the renderer repo is dist-only): MathML element-coverage cases and the mml3 transform semantics.
JEuclid's MathML rendering test cases, from the maintained fork (the project's canonical home is SourceForge; no GitHub org repo exists).
WebKit's per-construct MathML layout and rendering expectations.
The incumbent's fixtures (the canonical lasem repository; the plurimath/lasem-ruby rewrite carries no fixtures) - the corpus logifos must beat before Lasem retires.
